entries.name: 横向眩光与椭圆散景
entries.use_when: 项目已选择变形宽银幕观感，并存在亮源或离焦背景
entries.ask: 亮源在哪，眩光会不会盖住脸和关键接触？
entries.description: Where the established bright source enters the lens, allow a restrained horizontal flare; out-of-focus highlights may take a vertically elongated shape while the required subject remains readable.
entries.avoid: 不自动改画幅或焦距；不保证任意镜头/光圈都产生同样眩光。

entries.name: 柔和的人像焦点过渡
entries.use_when: 人像需要柔和过渡但仍保留身份轮廓
entries.ask: 哪只眼或哪只手必须锐利，柔化从哪一深度开始？
entries.description: Keep the required eyes and facial landmarks readable, with a gentle transition toward the out-of-focus background and restrained highlights across the skin.
entries.avoid: 不把暖色当作改肤色授权；不以器材名替代焦点对象。

entries.name: 受控的复古边缘缺陷
entries.use_when: 批准风格允许边缘旋转感、色边或高光晕染
entries.ask: 缺陷只放在哪片非关键边缘，何处必须保持身份清楚？
entries.description: Confine the chosen vintage softness or color fringing to nonessential frame edges; keep faces, text and the decisive action free of distracting artifacts.
entries.avoid: 不同时把所有缺陷叠满；不声称品牌必然产生固定颜色的光晕。

entries.name: 干净透视与克制焦外
entries.use_when: 几何、身份和材质识别优先于光学装饰
entries.ask: 哪些直线、轮廓或五官是必须保持清楚的参照？
entries.description: Prioritize clean geometric edges, readable facial structure and unobtrusive defocus; avoid adding optical artifacts that compete with the required action.
entries.avoid: Master与Signature不当作同一镜头；不用零畸变、零色差或零噪声保证。

entries.name: 细颗粒与温和高光过渡
entries.use_when: 批准的写实风格需要可感但不抢戏的胶片质感
entries.ask: 颗粒在当前输出尺寸能否保留细节，高光周围是否真的需要晕染？
entries.description: Use restrained fine grain and a gradual highlight transition, keeping faces and small narrative objects readable; any warm highlight bloom stays local to the established bright sources.
entries.avoid: 不把胶片型号当固定调色LUT或暗部细节保证。

entries.name: 自然日光色与克制纹理
entries.use_when: 项目需要自然日光观感与稳定的物件颜色
entries.ask: 人物身份色和环境色哪项必须守住，是否还需要额外色偏？
entries.description: Preserve the established daylight color relationships and recognizable object colors, with restrained texture and smooth transitions between lit and shaded surfaces.
entries.avoid: 不凭型号许诺宽容度；没有日光时不新增太阳。

entries.name: 有层级的黑白颗粒
entries.use_when: 项目明确批准黑白表达
entries.ask: 失去色相区别后，相邻衣料、皮肤和背景靠什么明度或边缘区分？
entries.description: Use the approved monochrome palette with deliberate value separation and controlled grain; preserve the necessary shape information in the dark clothing and background.
entries.avoid: 黑白不是随意移除已承担叙事功能的颜色；不把纯黑压死当普遍优点。

entries.name: 亮源局部柔化
entries.use_when: 现有亮源需要柔化，高光锐利感抢过人物
entries.ask: 光晕允许扩到哪里，暗衣和背景的分离是否仍可读？
entries.description: Allow a small, controlled bloom around the established highlights while preserving enough local separation for the required face, hands and dark surfaces.
entries.avoid: 柔化可能影响反差；不宣称绝不抬黑、不损细节或固定滤镜强度跨场景一致。

entries.name: 保留关键细节的柔光
entries.use_when: 人物希望稍柔和而非纹理完全消失
entries.ask: 哪部分身份细节不能柔掉，背景亮点是否过分抢眼？
entries.description: Soften distracting fine harshness without erasing the specified identity landmarks; keep highlight diffusion subordinate to the face and action.
entries.avoid: 不承诺任何光位下零雾化或完美肤色；先描述目标再决定是否用器材别名。

entries.name: 局部网状柔化观感
entries.use_when: 明确批准旧电影式柔化或特殊亮点形态
entries.ask: 这种柔化为哪个观看目的服务，能否局限在非关键高光？
entries.description: Use the approved soft, slightly textured highlight treatment sparingly, keeping the silhouette and critical action legible.
entries.avoid: 不强制所有亮点成星芒，不把源图网纹当人物衣料。

entries.name: 有来源的光与几何轮廓
entries.use_when: 已有环境光可组织人物和建筑关系
entries.ask: 哪个已存在光源承担主要分离，必要暗部仍能辨认吗？
entries.description: Let the established motivated light organize the main silhouette and architectural planes; retain only the shadow separation needed for the narrative objects.
entries.avoid: 这是源文启发的可选观感，不是对创作者全部作品的定义；不强制单光源或8:1。

entries.name: 有叙事依据的色彩对照
entries.use_when: 已批准的色彩结构需要明确主次关系
entries.ask: 哪两类已有色面形成对照，是否误改人物身份色？
entries.description: Organize the approved dominant and accent colors around the intended point of attention, preserving established costume and object colors.
entries.avoid: 不把颜色与情绪写成固定对应，不用色温替代完整色相说明。

entries.name: 城市光色与主观运动痕迹
entries.use_when: 项目批准主观都市观感且现场已有相应光源
entries.ask: 运动痕迹在哪段表达主观时间，哪些脸和动作必须仍清楚？
entries.description: Use the established practical city colors and, only where approved, localized motion trails that express the selected subjective moment without hiding identity or action.
entries.avoid: 不擅改交付fps，不把低快门/抽帧当任何生成模型可保证的技术执行。

entries.name: 巨大负空间与哑光体量
entries.use_when: 已有巨构需要用空域和尺度关系表达重量
entries.ask: 已有哪个小尺度参照能留下，尘雾是否真的存在？
entries.description: Use the approved negative space and large quiet matte planes to separate the established small subject from the larger structure; preserve a readable scale reference.
entries.avoid: 不凭风格新增尘雾或建筑，不把去饱和当所有场景必选。

entries.name: 武侠实景中的冷暖材质分离
entries.use_when: 已有实景武侠项目允许冷暖照明关系
entries.ask: 火光、天光或雨水哪些确实存在，剑与衣料在此光下怎样区分？
entries.description: Separate the existing blade, cloth and skin through their distinct responses to the approved warm and cool sources, keeping the action plane clear.
entries.avoid: 不自动添加风雨、烟雾、仰拍或双光源。

entries.name: 克制暗调与必要色面
entries.use_when: 批准的悬疑暗调需要清楚的层次
entries.ask: 当前暗部里哪张脸、哪只手、哪个出口必须仍可辨？
entries.description: Keep the approved low-key palette controlled, using selective separation so the required face, hand or exit remains readable against the darker environment.
entries.avoid: 不强制橄榄黄、8:1光比或零噪声；摄影风格不决定人物心理。

entries.name: 明确重音与几何碎片形
entries.use_when: 已批准动画冲击需要重音和可读碎片设计
entries.ask: 哪一项强调最能解释接触，碎片来自哪个已损坏物件？
entries.description: Emphasize the approved contact through a readable impact pose and, where breakage already occurs, clearly grouped fragment shapes with an explicit departure and settling path.
entries.avoid: 不自动全套加入闪光、拍二、方块碎片或零重力。

entries.name: 受力后的拖随与收势
entries.use_when: 已有动作需要表现重量和次级运动
entries.ask: 主运动先停在哪里，哪件现成衣摆或附件随后才停？
entries.description: Keep the primary action readable, then let the existing cloth or attached elements follow and settle with a clear relationship to that motion.
entries.avoid: 不擅加烟雾或附件，不把作画师名作为完整动作。

entries.name: 清楚剪影与夸张几何
entries.use_when: 批准风格允许夸张透视和硬边色块
entries.ask: 夸张的轮廓是否仍能认出人物并读懂受力方向？
entries.description: Use the approved exaggerated perspective and decisive silhouette to clarify the action, with controlled hard-edged color grouping and an identifiable recovery pose.
entries.avoid: 不覆盖身份比例锁，不强制所有镜头高饱和或鱼眼。

entries.name: 逆光与分层空气深度
entries.use_when: 场景已有逆光且批准风格需要明亮空间层次
entries.ask: 逆光源实际在哪，轮廓光和空气层是否遮掉关键面部？
entries.description: Use the established backlight and layered atmospheric values to separate depth, reserving the clearest contrast for the required face or narrative object.
entries.avoid: 不自动新增云海、镜头光斑或彩色边缘，不把柔光扩到所有表面。

entries.name: 有层级的粗线与暗面笔触
entries.use_when: 批准2D画风需要粗粝线条或排线
entries.ask: 线条粗细在哪个焦点变化，排线会不会吞掉脸和动作剪影？
entries.description: Use the approved rough line weight and selective hatching on supporting shadow planes, keeping facial landmarks and the action silhouette distinct.
entries.avoid: 工作室名不能代表所有作品；不强制通篇炭笔、棕色或脏纹理。

entries.name: 三维赛璐璐与局部材质差异
entries.use_when: 批准媒介是三维卡通渲染
entries.ask: 哪些大面用阶梯阴影，哪些近处材质允许局部高光差？
entries.description: Use clean stepped shadow groups on the approved stylized forms; distinguish the existing cloth and metal at visible scale without covering the face in microtexture.
entries.avoid: 不固定2–3px轮廓光，不靠品牌自动继承角色、服装或色板。

entries.name: 写实表面的粗糙度与光路差异
entries.use_when: 写实或写实CG表面缺少光照响应差异
entries.ask: 同一个光源照到相邻表面时，高光范围和可见反射为何不同？
entries.description: Describe the established source and the distinct rough or polished responses of each visible surface, maintaining coherent contact shadows and a readable material hierarchy.
entries.avoid: 提示词中的引擎名不启用引擎功能，不保证光追、真实渲染算法或计算精度。

entries.name: 已有湿面中的局部城市反光
entries.use_when: 场景已经存在湿面与发光标志
entries.ask: 哪个已存在亮源被哪片湿面反射，哪些地方仍是干燥的？
entries.description: Restrict the existing city-light reflections to the approved wet patches and appropriate viewing surfaces; retain dry areas and the original source colors.
entries.avoid: 不自动造雨、积水、霓虹招牌或全息UI。

entries.name: 皮肤的柔和层次
entries.use_when: 可见皮肤过塑料、过蜡或细节过密
entries.ask: 当前景别看得见哪个面部区域，背光或汗液有没有真实依据？
entries.description: Keep the established skin tone and broad form readable, with restrained soft highlights; only show thin-edge translucency or localized moisture where the lighting and current state support it.
entries.ink: 以面部转折的墨色浓淡与边缘软硬区分明暗，保留五官，不加入照片毛孔或镜面汗珠。
entries.cel: 用少量清楚的肤色/阴影色面表达转折，必要高光集中在当前可见部位，不叠写实毛孔。
entries.avoid: 不自动加汗、不凭SSS词推断生理状态，不在远景要求毛孔。

entries.name: 氧化或粗糙铁面
entries.use_when: 现有粗糙金属与抛光面混成统一塑料高光
entries.ask: 哪片表面已被确认粗糙或氧化，磨亮部位有没有使用依据？
entries.description: Let the established rough iron read through broad subdued highlights and uneven surface value; reserve brighter exposed edges for wear already present in the approved state.
entries.ink: 以干涩短笔和低反差墨块表示已确认粗糙铁面，亮边留白仅放在可见受光棱角。
entries.cel: 粗铁主体保持低对比色面，少量不规则明暗块提示粗糙度；磨亮边只画已成立部位。
entries.avoid: 不新增锈蚀/损坏，不混淆涂漆覆盖层与裸露金属。

entries.name: 抛光钢的方向高光
entries.use_when: 现有光洁金属需要区别于粗糙铁面
entries.ask: 已存在亮源沿哪个可见平面反射，转动时亮带怎样变化？
entries.description: Give the established polished steel a controlled directional highlight from the approved source, allowing that highlight to shift with the visible surface orientation while the form stays readable.
entries.ink: 以窄留白沿当前受光刃面分离硬边，转向时改变留白位置，不叠加照片镜面贴图。
entries.cel: 以简洁硬边亮带区别刀身主色，亮带随表面转向变化，刃形保持连续。
entries.avoid: 不把所有金属都写成镜面，不要求未知拉丝方向、完美反射或新增刃口。

entries.name: 干燥织物的纤维与大褶皱
entries.use_when: 已有粗织物过亮或织纹盖住表演
entries.ask: 这一镜能看清整件衣服的褶皱，还是近处一小块织纹？衣料是否仍是干燥状态？
entries.description: Keep the established dry woven cloth mostly matte, describing its broad folds first and limiting fibrous detail to the visible near surface; let its response remain distinct from adjacent skin and polished metal.
entries.ink: 用干笔边缘和褶皱的浓淡转折表达粗布，近处可见边角才给少量飞白，不铺满织纹。
entries.cel: 以大褶皱的色面转折和克制边缘纹理表现干布，不给全衣统一塑料高光。
entries.avoid: 原文亚麻启发扩展为干织物观察方法，不更换既有衣料、颜色或干湿状态。

entries.name: 丝绸随褶皱转向的亮带
entries.use_when: 已确认丝料需要体现柔滑与方向变化
entries.ask: 哪道可见褶皱正朝向光源，亮带能否沿它变化而保持原色？
entries.description: Let a restrained sheen follow the visible folds of the established silk under the approved light, preserving its base color and keeping unlit areas quieter.
entries.ink: 沿已成立丝绸褶皱安排连续柔滑墨面与细长留白，底色/身份纹样保持，不强塞PBR反射。
entries.cel: 用顺着褶皱的简洁亮带与稳定主色表现丝料，亮带只在当前受光面出现。
entries.avoid: 不默认红丝绸变金色，不凭空新增刺绣纹样或湿痕。

entries.name: 有使用依据的木面分区
entries.use_when: 已有木面缺少受光与使用区分
entries.ask: 哪片木面在镜头里可见，磨亮或落灰是否已由资产和状态确认？
entries.description: Keep the established wood grain aligned with the visible form, separating the approved rubbed areas from quieter surrounding planes; show dust or wear only where it already belongs.
entries.ink: 以顺结构的稀疏笔纹表示木面，大面保留安静墨色，磨亮处仅用已有光向下的留白区分。
entries.cel: 木纹合并成少量顺结构的长形，焦点附近才保留局部纹理，不让桌面盖过手与物件。
entries.avoid: 不新增年轮、灰尘或古旧损坏，不把所有木材都当榆木。

entries.name: 液面与容器中的局部光影
entries.use_when: 已有液体需要可读表面或轻微扰动
entries.ask: 液体当前是静止还是被哪件已发生动作扰动？容器和光源在哪里？
entries.description: Let the approved liquid surface reflect the established source within its container; if the confirmed action disturbs it, describe the visible ripple or displacement and its settling state.
entries.ink: 以容器内的留白和弧形墨线表达液面，只有已发生扰动才出现波纹，保持容器边界。
entries.cel: 用少量反光色块和清楚的液面线表现容器内液体，扰动依照当前动作而非自发波动。
entries.avoid: 不默认油膜彩虹、空气震爆、悬浮液滴或新溢出；汤的颜色/浑浊度沿用来源。
